Prior distributions

Source: R/priors.R
priors.Rd

lognormal() is used for typical values of structural parameters (its meanlog and sdlog are on the log scale), normal() for estimated covariate effects, and half_normal() for standard deviations.

Usage

lognormal(meanlog, sdlog)

normal(mean, sd)

half_normal(scale)

Arguments

meanlog, sdlog

Mean and standard deviation on the log scale.

mean, sd

Mean and standard deviation.

scale

Scale of a half-normal distribution.

Value

An object of class bpk_prior.

Examples

lognormal(log(5), 0.5)
#> $dist
#> [1] "lognormal"
#> 
#> $mu
#> [1] 1.609438
#> 
#> $sd
#> [1] 0.5
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "bpk_prior"
half_normal(0.5)
#> $dist
#> [1] "half_normal"
#> 
#> $mu
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $sd
#> [1] 0.5
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "bpk_prior"
